technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with overbought conditions limiting upside probability; RSI and trend indicators show strength but price remains below key moving averages with weak volume confirmation.

fundamental.summary: WY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 21 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (11+ months old) with no recent conviction signals, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (351.84), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, NFP event today, and earnings in 21 days create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI rising, supertrend bullish, and extreme market fear (29/100) create contrarian opportunity with price near support (29.93) and technical momentum indicators aligned.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price below both 50-day moving averages, negative volume (CMF/AO), VIX crisis levels, macro headwinds (USD/yield curve), earnings in 21 days, and zero smart money conviction make risk/reward unfavorable.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI rising and supertrend bullish with price at support (29.93) offer technical entry, but overbought oscillators and negative volume confirmation severely limit probability of sustained upside.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (351.84), macro headwinds (USD/yield curve), earnings in 21 days, and zero smart money conviction create compounded downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding WY with 39 existing Real Estate positions (9% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; earnings proximity (21 days) mandates reduced sizing if entered.
